resale_co.name: Rental / Resale Certificate (continuing certificate of occupancy) for one- and two-family homes
resale_co.issued_by: Borough of New Milford Building Department (Construction Official), with Public Works (sidewalks), Zoning and Fire sign-offs
resale_co.lead_time: Schedule all inspections at least two weeks before closing. Inspections are Monday or Thursday, 1:00 to 4:00 pm. Code says the Construction Official acts within 10 days of the application.
resale_co.valid_for: One certificate valid for six (6) months.
requirements: All open permits closed and final inspections done (water heater, furnace, AC, renovations, decks, pools); unpermitted work needs permits
Smoke detector on each level including walk-up attic and basement; 10-year sealed battery type
Carbon monoxide detector within 10 feet of the bedroom areas in the hallway (more if bedrooms are in separate areas)
Sump pump may not drain into the sanitary sewer line
Handrails on any steps with 3 steps and a platform (two handrails if wider than 3 feet)
House numbers visible from the street
Hydrant on the property visible and not blocked
Property neat and clean, no excessive debris or overgrown shrubs
Sidewalks and aprons must comply; DPW inspects; repairs or a buyer's attorney escrow letter (repair within 30 days of closing)
Secondary power sources (generator, solar) labeled near the main panel and meter
Running bamboo must be disclosed and, if uncontained, abated or escrowed
Application asks about oil tanks, private wells (safety/health test) and sump pumps
For a demolition sale, a buyer's attorney letter is needed and smoke/CO inspection is still required

fees.label: Rental/Resale Certificate, one- and two-family homes (one certificate covering fire, building and sidewalk)
Continuing certificate of occupancy application (Borough code 10-7.4)
fees.quote: The fee for the application for the continuing certificate of occupancy shall be $50.

resale_co.how_to_apply: Complete the Borough's Rental / Resale Certificate Application (One- and Two-Family Homes), with seller, buyer and both attorneys' details, and submit it to the Building Department, 930 River Road, with the $100.00 fee. Inspections are scheduled for Monday or Thursday afternoons. Call (201) 967-5044 ext 5415 or 5560.
resale_co.contact_title: Building Department Technical Assistant (Construction Official: Alan Silverman, asilverman@newmilfordnj.gov, ext. 7572)

evidence.quote: RENTAL / RESALE CERTIFICATE APPLICATION ONE- AND TWO-FAMILY HOMES

After all required inspections are completed and approved, one certificate valid for six (6) months will be issued after the Construction Official signs it. The certificate will include Fire, Building, and Sidewalk compliance.
ALL INSPECTIONS SHOULD BE SCHEDULED AT LEAST TWO WEEKS BEFORE CLOSING
No residential premises located in the Zoning District A shall be sold or purchased without the issuance of a continuing certificate of occupancy.
The seller or buyer of the premises about to be sold, or his respective agents, shall apply to the Construction Official for a certificate of occupancy
Building Department TA / Planning Board Secretary

resale_co.notes: The Borough's 2026 Rental / Resale Certificate Application (one- and two-family homes) and checklist make one combined certificate covering fire, building and sidewalk compliance for $100.00. Borough code Section 10-7 (read through the ecode360 print view) requires a continuing certificate of occupancy before any sale of residential premises in 'Zoning District A' and still lists a $50 fee (Ord. No. 2007:17), which looks out of date. The Borough's forms page also has an older 'CCO - Residential Resale '26' Word version of the same form. Nicole Piano's directory email is shown as npiano@newmilford nj.gov (the mailto link points to npiano@newmilfordboro.com). Rental-only items (lead paint inspections for rentals, landlord registration, the $35 rental smoke inspection) are not sale requirements.

requirements: Smoke detector on each level including walk-up attic and basement
Battery smoke detectors must be 10-year sealed units listed to ANSI/UL 217 (hardwired units are not affected)
Carbon monoxide detector within 10 feet of the bedroom areas in the hallway; extra units if bedrooms are in separate areas

authorities.name: New Milford Bureau of Fire Prevention (inspected as part of the Borough Rental/Resale Certificate)
authorities.lead_time: Schedule at least two weeks before closing; fire inspections Monday or Thursday 1:00 to 4:00 pm.

fire_cert.notes: For sales, the smoke/CO check is part of the single $100 Rental/Resale Certificate. The Building Department page separately describes a $35 Fire Prevention Bureau smoke/CO inspection, but only for rentals. The checklist still uses the old certificate name that includes the portable fire extinguisher but lists no extinguisher requirement (the state dropped it in February 2025, P.L.2025, c.19). Alan Silverman is also the fire official for River Edge; the state directory lists a personal-looking email (Firemusik@aol.com), so the Borough email is given here.

other_items.label: Sidewalks and aprons (DPW)
other_items.detail: Public Works inspects sidewalks; broken slabs must be repaired by a registered contractor or homeowner and reinspected, or the buyer's attorney gives an escrow letter that sidewalks will be repaired within 30 days of closing.

other_items.label: Running bamboo disclosure
other_items.detail: Seller must tell the buyer about running bamboo; uncontained bamboo must be abated before sale or escrowed (50% prepaid, balance held by the buyer's attorney). Borough ordinance 12-6.

other_items.label: Open permits
other_items.detail: All open permits must be closed and final inspections completed before closing; unpermitted water heaters and furnaces need permits.

other_items.label: Sump pump
other_items.detail: Sump pumps may not drain into the sanitary sewer line.

other_items.label: Oil tank and private well questions
other_items.detail: The application asks whether an oil tank is present (in use or properly abandoned) and whether a private well has had a safety/health test.

open_questions: Is there any extra fee for reinspections or for short-notice inspections?
Does the $50 code fee in Section 10-7.4 still apply anywhere, or only the $100 form fee?
